mapper.select: SELECT a.name AS areaName, a.station_count AS stationCount, a.lon AS longitude, a.lat AS latitude FROM area_info a WHERE a.deleted = 0

SELECT area_name AS areaName, NULL AS stationType, station_count AS stationCount FROM ( SELECT a.name AS area_name, COUNT(s.id) AS station_count FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN area_info a ON a.id = s.area_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.name ) t1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS areaName, s.type AS stationType, COUNT(s.id) AS stationCount FROM station_info s WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(cpl.today_order_count), 0) AS orderCount, IFNULL(AVG(de.progress), 0) AS expandProgress, IFNULL(SUM(tp.use_count), 0) AS permissionUseCount FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN charge_park_link cpl ON s.id = cpl.station_id LEFT JOIN debt_expand de ON s.id = de.station_id LEFT JOIN time_permission tp ON s.id = tp.station_id WHERE s.deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalAreaCount, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM station_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND area_id IS NOT NULL) AS coverStationCount FROM area_info WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalStationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已生效' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalOperateCount FROM station_info WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalSpaceCount, SUM(CASE WHEN real_status = '空闲' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS availableSpaceCount FROM parking_space_info WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM time_permission WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效') + (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM fee_rule WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效') + (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效') ) AS effectiveRuleCount FROM DUAL
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(recovery_rate), 0) AS recoveryRate FROM debt_expand WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(deposit_order_count), 0) AS depositOrderCount FROM deposit_plan WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT s.name AS stationName, a.lon AS longitude, a.lat AS latitude FROM station_info s left join area_info a on s.area_id = a.id WHERE s.deleted = 0

SELECT p.location AS parkSpaceName, a.lon AS longitude, a.lat AS latitude FROM parking_space_info p
left join station_info s on p.station_id = s.id left join area_info a on s.area_id = a.id WHERE p.deleted = 0
SELECT s.type AS stationType, COUNT(s.id) AS stationCount FROM station_info s WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.type
select s.name as stationName, coalesce(avg(d.recovery_rate),0) as recoverFinish from debt_expand d left join station_info s on d.station_id=s.id group by s.name

SELECT id, area_no AS areaNo, name, district, address, station_count AS stationCount, status, phone, remark FROM area_info WHERE deleted = 0
ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.station_no AS stationNo, s.name, s.type, s.address, s.status, s.operate_type AS operateType, s.space_total AS spaceTotal, a.name AS areaName, s.remark FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN area_info a ON s.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.station_no AS stationNo, s.name, s.type, s.address, s.status, s.operate_type AS operateType, s.space_total AS spaceTotal, a.name AS areaName, s.remark FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN area_info a ON s.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.area_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.station_no AS stationNo, s.name, s.type, s.address, s.status, s.operate_type AS operateType, s.space_total AS spaceTotal, a.name AS areaName, s.remark FROM station_info s LEFT JOIN area_info a ON s.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = '已生效'
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.space_no AS spaceNo, p.location, p.type, p.device_type AS deviceType, p.real_status AS realStatus, s.name AS stationName, p.remark FROM parking_space_info p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0
ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.space_no AS spaceNo, p.location, p.type, p.device_type AS deviceType, p.real_status AS realStatus, s.name AS stationName, p.remark FROM parking_space_info p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.real_status = '空闲'
ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, station_id AS stationId, CONVERT(time_range USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ruleName, CONVERT('时段权限' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ruleType, CONVERT(status USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS status, create_time AS createTime FROM time_permission WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效'
UNION ALL
SELECT id, station_id AS stationId, CONVERT(rate_type USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ruleName, CONVERT('收费规则' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ruleType, CONVERT(status USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS status, create_time AS createTime FROM fee_rule WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效'
UNION ALL
SELECT id, station_id AS stationId, CONVERT(discount_type USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ruleName, CONVERT('充停联动' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS ruleType, CONVERT(status USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AS status, create_time AS createTime FROM charge_park_link WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '已生效'
) t ORDER BY createTime DESC

SELECT d.id, s.name AS stationName, d.station_id AS stationId, d.type, d.range, d.progress, d.recovery_rate AS recoveryRate, d.status, d.remark, d.create_time AS createTime FROM debt_expand d LEFT JOIN station_info s ON d.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0
ORDER BY d.id DESC
